profile.name: Arif Fadly Siregar
profile.prompt: describe arif fadly siregar in one sentence
headlines: I build AI systems that ship: RAG pipelines, OCR ingestion, and the mobile apps people actually open.
I turn messy financial PDFs into answers an LLM can defend, then ship the app that asks the questions.
Seven years of Android, iOS and web, now pointed at retrieval, reasoning and evaluation.
From a 70M-user wallet to RAG over fund statements: software first, models where they earn their place.
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer & AI Engineer with 7+ years across FinTech, EdTech, HealthTech and telecom, building RAG systems, LLM pipelines and cross-platform apps.
profile.bio:
I'm a software engineer who moved down the stack into models. I spent years shipping Android and iOS apps at scale, including DANA, one of Indonesia's largest fintech platforms, and now I design retrieval-augmented generation systems, OCR ingestion pipelines and LLM evaluation loops for private credit and fund accounting at Interopera.

I care about the whole path from raw document to trusted answer: chunking that respects layout, retrieval you can measure, graph-based reasoning for multi-step calculations, and an interface that makes the result usable.

Along the way I've led mobile teams, built CI/CD from scratch, reverse-engineered apps to harden them against MITM and location spoofing, and published research on CNN-based fabric classification.

projects.title: Interopera
projects.summary: AI infrastructure for private credit and fund accounting: RAG-based financial analysis over capital calls, distributions and NAV statements.
projects.description:
Designed a RAG architecture with LangGraph that turns structured and unstructured fund data into a queryable knowledge base, with graph-based reasoning for multi-step calculations (MOIC, DPI, TVPI, IRR).

Built the OCR ingestion pipeline for high-volume scanned PDFs (Tesseract, LandingAI, custom layout detection and field extraction), plus evaluation loops for model performance and a Next.js chat-and-analytics interface.

projects.title: Ulos fabric classification

projects.title: Geolancer
projects.summary: Crowdsourced POI collection, rewarded in crypto. On-device blur detection and a hardened client.

Audited the app by reverse-engineering it with JADX and Ghidra, and added SSL pinning against MITM and checks against location spoofing.
